name: FPT Corporation
summary: FPT Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) and telecommunication products and services in Vietnam and internationally. It operates through Information Technology and Telecommunication; and Investment, Education and Others segments. The company offers internet services to individuals, households, and enterprises, including internet leased line, domestic and international telecommunication, domain, hosting, web portal, and IPTV services; and online services, such as online newspapers and advertising, online music and payment services, and advertising systems.
